findings.finding: On 24 Nov, two sessions before the print, CI Games moved Lords of the Fallen II from 'Q1 2027' to 'April 2027', its second slip after the June 2026 delay out of 2026; the stock fell 1.9% on 24 Nov and 0.8% on 25 Nov, far less than the 9.1% on the June delay, so the Q3 report's commentary on the date, budget and launch cash may extend the digestion slightly.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: June 2026 delay to Q1 2027: -9.13% on 24 Jun 2026 on 1.59m shares, then -1.97% and -0.89%; this slip: -1.86% (24 Nov) and -0.84% (25 Nov) on normal volume
findings.original_quote: the release of Lords of the Fallen II ("LOTF II") is planned for April 2027. The exact release date of LOTF II will be publicly announced in December 2026. (English version of RB 39/2026; the Polish version prevails and could not be fetched from espi.pap.pl)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it has been public for one to two sessions on a $137k/day name. If the market were still digesting it, 25 Nov would not have closed only 0.8% lower on below-average volume (168k shares). The residual is that the report is the first document in which management can be asked about cost and cash to April against a loan due 31 Aug 2027.
findings.independence: June 2026 delay coverage showing the prior window was Q1 2027: https://www.gematsu.com/2026/06/lords-of-the-fallen-ii-delayed-to-q1-2027 ; Edison price stamp of -1.86% on 24/11/2026: https://www.edisongroup.com/research/q126-solid-but-all-eyes-on-h2/BM-3427/

findings.finding: The liquidity overhang that would otherwise dominate a 30 Sep balance sheet (PKO loans rolled to 30 Oct and then 6 Nov) was closed before the print: a EUR 28.6m KUKE-guaranteed syndicated loan due 31 Aug 2027 repaid every PKO/Erste facility on 6 Nov and funds the completion and release of LOTF II, so the Q3 report's going-concern and subsequent-events notes should read clean.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Refinancing announced 30 Oct: -2.5% on 30 Oct, -3.4% on 2 Nov on 569k shares (high volume), then +6.8% from 2 Nov to 9 Nov around the 6 Nov repayment; no prior results-day reaction on this line
findings.original_quote: w dniu 30 października 2026 roku Spółka zawarła z PKO Bank Polski S.A. ... aneks ... na podstawie którego termin spłaty kredytu został wydłużony do dnia 6 listopada 2026 roku (RB 35/2026, Polish original via Biznesradar: 'on 30 October 2026 the Company concluded with PKO ... an annex under which the loan repayment date was extended to 6 November 2026'); loan terms quoted from the English RB 36/2026: 'in the amount of EUR 28,600,000.00 ... for the purpose of repaying the Company's existing loans ... as well as financing ... the completion of production and the release of the game Lords of the Fallen II. The Loan is due for repayment on 31 August 2027.'
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: public for 3.5 weeks and the stock recovered from 2.245 to 2.49 around the repayment. What is not yet visible is the 30 Sep balance sheet itself and management's reading of the runway between an April 2027 launch and the 31 Aug 2027 maturity; if the market had fully priced the clean outcome there would be no residual, so this is sized near zero.
findings.independence: RB 38/2026 confirms the repayment happened: https://cigames.com/en/ci-games-se-37-2026-notification-of-the-pledge-of-ci-games-se-shares-by-the-person-discharging-managerial-responsibilities/ (same issuer, different document)

baseline_tension: Agrees mildly with the run-up (-2.89% 20d, -3.69% 5d, the latter largely the 24 Nov slip), so the slight negative lean adds little beyond the free control; with no register, nothing orthogonal to the run-up was found.
language_note: The Polish original of RB 35/2026 (via Biznesradar) carried the second roll of the PKO maturities to 6 Nov 2026, the cleanest evidence that the refinancing was a deadline event; the English version on the issuer site says the same, so it is corroboration rather than an exclusive.
StrefaInwestorow's 08:38 timestamp on last year's Q3 results story was the only session evidence found; no English source carried a timestamp.
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry: the issuer publishes English versions of every current report the same day.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the April 2027 slip (public 24 Nov) moved from -0.3 to -0.2 and the refinancing (public 30 Oct / 6 Nov) from +0.2 to +0.1.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and 'let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct': abs_move_pct raised from 3.0 to 3.5, because the Q3 numbers are not pre-released and the name is thin, even though its last three report days moved under 1.5%; p_up left at 48.
